WITH loan_disbursements AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM TO_DATE("Disbursement Date")) AS year,
        SUM("Loan Amount (Rs)") AS total_amount
    FROM shg_loan_register

SELECT

ORDER BY year;
